name: Blockbench

panel.offCreator: Turn on Creator mode to accept Blockbench.
panel.tokenHint: Only share the token with tools you trust. Regenerating disconnects Blockbench.
panel.hint1: 1. Install the Vibey plugin in Blockbench (vibey.js).
panel.hint2: 2. Vibey panel → Connect. With "Find game automatically" the plugin reads port and token from vibeyclient/devlink.json in the game folder.
panel.hint3: 3. Otherwise open Vibey → Live link settings… and enter the port and the token from this page.
